assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The diagnosis of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.91.
The diagnosis of atrial fibrillation is coded as I48.0.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is coded as CPT 93229.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The patient may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of the notice.
